column2: DANGER CO2 Vessel Closure Interlock Sign – Bypassed Interlock Lets Lid Open Live – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Bypassed Interlock Lets Lid Open Live. This DANGER CO2 Vessel Closure Interlock sign from CGAP Safety reads: CO2 VESSEL INTERLOCK / NEVER BYPASS OR DEFEAT / LID CAN OPEN UNDER / EXTREME PRESSURE. Written for CO2 extraction labs, hemp and botanical processors and flavor extract plants.

Why this sign matters

Defeating the pressure interlock allows the closure to be opened while the vessel is pressurized, causing violent release.

Where to post it

At closure interlock and pressure switch.

Who orders it

Extraction lab manager, CO2 extraction facility.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.169; ASME BPVC Sec VIII; manufacturer instructions. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
